Script.Name: ConfirmAccountNumberISOCUCW
Script.Title: Confirm Account Number
Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Account Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Account Number is undefined'); return; } var Account = document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber; var ConfirmAccount = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber; if (Account.value == "") { ConfirmAccount.value = ""; return; } else { var reMatch = /^\d{1,32}$/; if (!reMatch.test(Account.value)) { alert("Account Number must be numeric"); Account.value = ""; Account.focus(); return; } if ((!reMatch.test(ConfirmAccount.value)) && (ConfirmAccount.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Account Number must be numeric"); ConfirmAccount.value = ""; ConfirmAccount.focus(); return; } if ((Account.value != ConfirmAccount.value) && (ConfirmAccount.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Account Number does not match Account Number, \nplease re-enter Confirm Account Number"); ConfirmAccount.value = ""; ConfirmAccount.focus(); return; } }
Script.Comment: Validate that Account Number and Confirm Account Number match and are numeric.

Script.Name: ConfirmRoutingNumberISOCUCW
Script.Title: Confirm Routing Number
Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTBankRoutingNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Routing Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmBankRoutingNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Routing Number is undefined'); return; } Routing = document.form1.XPath_EFTBankRoutingNumber; ConfirmRouting = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmBankRoutingNumber; if (Routing.value == "") { ConfirmRouting.value = ""; return; } else { var reMatch = /\d{9}/; if (!reMatch.test(Routing.value)) { alert("Routing Number must be a 9 digit number"); Routing.value = ""; Routing.focus(); return; } if ((!reMatch.test(ConfirmRouting.value)) && (ConfirmRouting.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Routing Number must be a 9 digit number"); ConfirmRouting.value = ""; ConfirmRouting.focus(); return; } if ((Routing.value != ConfirmRouting.value) && (ConfirmRouting.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Routing Number does not match Routing Number, \nplease re-enter Confirm Routing Number"); ConfirmRouting.value = ""; ConfirmRouting.focus(); return; } }
Script.Comment: Validate that Routing Number and Confirm Routing Number match and are numeric.

Script.Name: DisableConfirmAccountNumberISOCUCW
Script.Title: Disable Confirm Account Number
Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber) == 'undefined' ) { alert('DisableConfirmAccountNumberISOGLCW : Account Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber) == 'undefined' ) { alert('DisableConfirmAccountNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Account Number is undefined'); return; } AccountNumber = document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber; Confirm = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber; DisableFieldFocus(AccountNumber,Confirm,"");

Script.Name: InstallmentPaymentsISOCUCW
Script.Title: Installment Payments
Script.Data: if ((typeof(document.form1.XPath_PaymentPlan) != 'undefined') && (typeof(document.form1.XPath_DownPaymentAmount) != 'undefined')) { if (typeof(document.form1.XPath_FollowOnPaymentType) != 'undefined') { var InstType = document.form1.XPath_FollowOnPaymentType; if (InstType.value == 'EFT') var FeeAmt = 0; else var FeeAmt = 5; } var PayPlan = document.form1.XPath_PaymentPlan; switch(PayPlan.value) { case 'Two Pay': var Percent = .50; var Dep = .50; break; case '4 Pay': var Percent = .20; var Dep = .40; break; case 'Monthly': var Percent = .083; var Dep = .083; break; } CalculatePayments(Dep,Percent,FeeAmt); }
Script.Comment: Call CalculatePayments script and pass required parameters.
